segments.ja408:1.3: Tamaddasaṃ phalahetu vibhaggaṃ, taṃ disvā bhikkhācariyaṃ carāmi.
segments.ja408:2.1: Selaṃ sumaṭṭhaṃ naravīraniṭṭhitaṃ [naravidduniṭṭhitaṃ (ka.)], nārī yugaṃ dhārayi appasaddaṃ;
segments.ja408:2.3: Dutiyañca āgamma ahosi saddo, taṃ disvā bhikkhācariyaṃ carāmi.
segments.ja408:3.1: Dijā dijaṃ kuṇapamāharantaṃ, ekaṃ samānaṃ bahukā samecca;
segments.ja408:3.3: Āhārahetū paripātayiṃsu, taṃ disvā bhikkhācariyaṃ carāmi.
segments.ja408:4.3: Tamaddasaṃ kāmahetu vitunnaṃ, taṃ disvā bhikkhācariyaṃ carāmi.
segments.ja408:6.1: Sabbepime devasamā samāgatā, aggī yathā pajjalito tathevime;
segments.ja408:6.3: Ahampi eko carissāmi bhaggavi, hitvāna kāmāni yathodhikāni.
segments.ja408:7.1: Ayameva kālo na hi añño atthi, anusāsitā me na bhaveyya pacchā;
segments.ja408:7.3: Ahampi ekā carissāmi bhaggava, sakuṇīva muttā purisassa hatthā.
segments.ja408:8.1: Āmaṃ pakkañca jānanti, atho loṇaṃ aloṇakaṃ;
segments.ja408:8.3: Tamahaṃ disvāna pabbajiṃ, careva tvaṃ carāmahanti.
